[[Category:API patch changes]]
<blockquote {{apisummary.blizzquote}}>
DISCLAIMER: These notes are for addon authors and as such are focused specifically on addon-facing API and security changes only. Changes planned for other parts of the game (UI or otherwise) are not included here.
</blockquote>__TOC__

===2026-10-16===
[https://discord.com/channels/327414731654692866/1560468817363210260/1560468817363210260 {{apisummary.title|Forever 1.60.1 Beta Changes 5}}] (build 70425)
{{apisummary.header|Coming in WoW Forever 1.60.1 Beta 5}}
{{apisummary.heading|Addon Security}}
* The server ID and spawn ID portions of creature, vehicle, pet and game object [[GUID]]s have been replaced with obfuscated values to prevent comparison to determine [[Layering|layer]]. They remain stable and unique within your own session, and the GUID string format is otherwise unchanged.
{{apisummary.heading|Miscellaneous}}
* Nameplates are no longer shown for non-target units far above or below the player. This is controlled by the new <code>nameplateMaxVerticalDistance</code> and <code>nameplateMaxVerticalDistanceAtMaxRange</code> [[CVar]]s (a value of <code>0</code> disables the check).
* Importing an [[Edit Mode]] layout string from an older version no longer raises an error.
* The Forever player, target, pet, target-of-target, totem and focus frames, and the minimap header, have been reskinned and some of their child frames reorganized. Addons that skin or anchor to these frames may need to adjust things.

===2026-10-08===
[https://discord.com/channels/327414731654692866/1557873223746719905/1557873223746719905 {{apisummary.title|Forever 1.60.1 Beta Changes 4}}] (Build 70291)
{{apisummary.header|Coming in WoW Forever 1.60.1 Beta 4}}
{{apisummary.heading|Addon Security}}

* Trial accounts can no longer send addon messages.
* {{api|C_ChatInfo.SendChatMessage|SendChatMessage}} with the "EMOTE" chat type now requires a hardware event when called from addon code outside of instances, matching the existing restriction on "SAY" and "YELL".
* Fixed a further issue that allowed addons to access minimap rotation values during encounters.
* Added a new <code>FrameStrata</code> [[secret aspects|secret aspect]]. {{api|Frame_GetFrameStrata|GetFrameStrata}} now returns a [[Secret_Values|secret value]] for [[Frame|frames]] that have this aspect.

{{apisummary.heading|Miscellaneous}}
* <span class="apitype">Forever</span> is now accepted as an alias for <span class="apitype">Camelot</span> in TOC file suffixes (e.g. <code>MyAddon_<span class="apitype">Forever</span>.toc</code>), in the <code>[<span class="apialt">Game</span>]</code> variable, and in game-type folder lookup.
* The {{api|require}} functionality recently added to Lua has been renamed to {{api|import}}.
* {{api|C_PvP.IsWarModeFeatureEnabled}} now returns false in Forever.
* {{api|GetInspectHonorData}} now returns two additional values: the inspected player's current honor and the honor needed for their next level.
* [[Edit Mode]] layouts are now saved separately for each UI type (mouse and keyboard vs. gamepad).

===2026-09-15===
[https://discord.com/channels/327414731654692866/1549523107520188476 {{apisummary.title|An Update On Secrets In WoW: Forever}}]
<blockquote {{apisummary.blizzquote}}>
WoW Forever shares Mainline WoW's UI architecture, including the vast majority of APIs available in 12.1.5. From a UI loading perspective, the easiest way to think about it is that Forever and modern WoW (Midnight) are two game types within the Mainline code family: Camelot (to be renamed before launch) and Standard, respectively.

The addon disarmament changes introduced in Midnight, including secrets, will also be active in Forever.

The AuraContainer/AuraButton changes introduced in 12.1.0 will be available as well, and you can expect similar UI changes in the future to be introduced to both Standard and Forever.
</blockquote>
